read_generations: read a file of JSON action trees and parse each into an ActionTree with top-down, DFS, and MRF representations
parse_action_trees: parse JSON action tree lines from a file into structured ActionTree objects with descriptions
extract_action_descriptions: extract action descriptions from JSON action tree dictionaries and remove them from the tree data
build_action_representations: build top-down, DFS, and MRF representations from an ActionTree root node
sample_generated_data: print a randomly selected parsed action tree entry from the generated data list
